specificationSources.finding: An active extendable event accepts lifetime promises through waitUntil.
respondWith adds its promise to event lifetime; each new write is attached before that response or existing refresh promise settles.

observations: Client WordCard cache factory is inside account-keyed app subtree and cleared on unmount. Server dictionary only shares exact public lesson sentences/words under validated lesson/language references.

Public game-generation caches exclude userWords/avoid/arbitrary topics. Static lesson content/decks and generated lesson lists use public module/curriculum inputs rather than private learner evidence.

Exam device snapshots/guidance use owner keys; speech takes are owner/attempt/item keyed and identity loss stops capture. Auth source retains owned drafts on unexpected identity loss and discards only after explicit successful signout.
Device-wide UI preferences/training hint counters remain shared. Search matches and this bounded manual review are not an app-wide privacy or browser account-isolation proof.

limits: Actual public/sw.js executed in Node VM with controlled Cache/fetch/event lifetime promises. This proves registration/settlement behavior, not physical browser termination, completed downloads, service-worker installation, device quota/durability or offline/phone acceptance.

One event-owned promise covers cache open and put while delivery stays independent. Storage failure is contained and does not assert successful offline saving. User agents may impose lifetime/storage limits.

General cache version18 upgrade purges prior general versions; completed named lesson packs remain. No new API/private route/Authorization/cross-origin response cache policy, no account data/schema/policy/speech/schedule/cleanup mutation.
